Job Description
Lead the overall planning, execution, and delivery of large-scale data centre development projects across South Korea
Provide strategic leadership and direction to project management, construction management, consultants, contractors, and supply chain partners throughout the project lifecycle
Drive project performance across key metrics including safety, quality, schedule, budget, risk, and operational readiness
Oversee development and permitting activities, ensuring compliance with all applicable South Korean regulations, codes, and industry standards
Partner with design consultants, project management teams, and contractors to develop integrated, efficient, and constructible design solutions
Lead project governance processes, ensuring alignment between business objectives, project execution strategies, and stakeholder expectations
Manage relationships with joint venture partners, government authorities, utility providers, contractors, consultants, and key project stakeholders
Provide executive oversight of procurement strategies, major contract negotiations, and vendor management activities
Ensure successful integration of Civil, Structural, Architectural, Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Fire Protection (MEPF) systems throughout project delivery
Review and challenge project execution plans, schedules, construction methodologies, and technical solutions to optimize delivery outcomes
Lead project cost management activities, including CAPEX planning, budget control, forecasting, financial reporting, and change management
Establish and maintain robust project controls, reporting frameworks, and governance structures to support effective decision-making
Oversee the development and maintenance of master project schedules, ensuring accurate tracking against approved baselines
Provide regular executive reporting on project progress, commercial performance, key risks, and mitigation strategies
Lead project risk management initiatives, facilitating risk identification, assessment, mitigation planning, and escalation processes
Ensure construction and commissioning activities achieve required operational, technical, safety, and quality standards
Collaborate closely with data centre operations teams to incorporate operational requirements into project design, procurement, commissioning, and handover processes
Support organizational initiatives relating to Compliance, ESG, Health & Safety, Business Continuity Planning (BCP), and internal and external audits
Act as a key liaison between local and international stakeholders, ensuring alignment on project objectives, expectations, and delivery strategies
Lead project closeout activities, ensuring successful completion of documentation, testing and commissioning requirements, lessons learned, and operational handover
Support broader asset management and operational initiatives, including tenant coordination, risk management, and strategic business objectives
Build, mentor, and lead high-performing project teams while fostering a collaborative and accountable project culture
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Architecture, Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, or a related discipline
Minimum 15 years of experience managing large-scale mission critical, industrial, infrastructure, or data centre development projects
Proven track record leading greenfield data centre developments from project inception through commissioning and operational handover
Extensive experience in project leadership roles with responsibility for large multidisciplinary teams and complex stakeholder environments
Strong understanding of mission critical facility design, construction, commissioning, and operational requirements
Demonstrated expertise in project governance, project controls, risk management, contract administration, and commercial management
Experience managing major contractors, consultants, suppliers, and joint venture partners on large-scale capital projects
Strong knowledge of Civil & Structural, Architectural, Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Fire Protection systems integration
Proven ability to manage significant CAPEX budgets and deliver projects within approved financial parameters
Experience working within both multinational and domestic business environments
Strong knowledge of South Korean construction regulations, permitting processes, and industry practices
Exceptional leadership, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
Ability to engage and influence senior executives, investors, project partners, regulatory authorities, and external stakeholders
Proficiency in project management and reporting tools, including Microsoft Project
Experience within hyperscale, colocation, or mission critical data centre environments is highly preferred
Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects in fast-paced, high-growth environments while maintaining a strong focus on safety, quality, and operational excellence
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance technical, operational, and financial objectives across large-scale development projects
Why Is This a Great Opportunity
We are partnering with a leading data centre developer and operator to appoint a
Project Senior Manager/Director
to lead the delivery of large-scale, mission-critical data centre developments in South Korea and this is a great opportunity to be part of our client's pioneer team in Korea for their 1st DC project in the country.
This strategic leadership role will be responsible for overseeing the full project lifecycle, from development, permitting, design management, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operational handover. This role will provide overall leadership across internal and external project teams, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
The successful candidate will serve as the primary interface between the organization, joint venture partners, consultants, contractors, suppliers, regulatory authorities, and data centre operations teams. This position requires a highly experienced leader with a strong background in mission critical infrastructure, exceptional stakeholder management capabilities, and the ability to navigate both local and international business environments.
